lines.beaver: 안녕하세요, 민준 씨. 오늘 몸 상태는 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello, Minjun. How are you feeling today?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo, minjun ssi. oneul mom sangtaeneun eottaeyo?
lines.learner: 어제 줄넘기를 오래 했더니 다리가 아파요.
lines.en: I jumped rope for a long time yesterday, and now my legs hurt.
lines.roman: eoje julleomkkireul orae haetdeoni dariga apayo.

lines.beaver: 운동량이 많았나 봐요. 몇 분 했어요?
lines.beaver_en: You must have exercised a lot. How many minutes?
lines.beaver_roman: undongnyangi mananna bwayo. myeot bun haesseoyo?
lines.en: About an hour. You have no idea how hard it was.
lines.roman: han sigan jjeumyo. eolmana himdeureonneunji mollayo.

lines.beaver: 한 시간은 무리예요. 처음엔 이십 분이 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: An hour is too much. Twenty minutes is good at first.
lines.beaver_roman: han siganeun murieyo. cheoeumen isip buni joayo.
lines.en: It seems my stamina is still weak.

lines.beaver: 괜찮아요. 오늘은 기구 운동을 가볍게 해요.
lines.beaver_en: That's okay. Today let's do light machine exercises.
lines.beaver_roman: gwaenchanayo. oneureun gigu undongeul gabyeopge haeyo.
lines.en: Okay. But which machine is good?

lines.beaver: 자전거 기구가 좋아요. 무릎에 부담이 적어요.
lines.beaver_en: The exercise bike is good. It's easy on the knees.
lines.beaver_roman: jajeongeo giguga joayo. mureupe budami jeogeoyo.
lines.learner: 아침에 조깅도 했더니 무릎이 좀 아파요.
lines.en: I also went jogging this morning, and my knees hurt a bit.
lines.roman: achime jogingdo haetdeoni mureupi jom apayo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 오늘은 조깅을 쉬세요. 요가는 해 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: Then skip jogging today. Have you tried yoga?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom oneureun jogingeul swiseyo. yoganeun hae bwasseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, I did yoga and my body felt lighter.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 요가는 근육을 풀어 줘서 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: Nice. Yoga is good because it relaxes your muscles.
lines.beaver_roman: jonneyo. yoganeun geunyugeul pureo jwoseo joayo.
lines.learner: 헬스클럽 요가 수업이 얼마나 좋은지 몰라요.
lines.en: You have no idea how good the gym's yoga class is.
lines.roman: helseukeulleop yoga sueobi eolmana joeunji mollayo.

lines.beaver: 운동 후에는 사우나도 하세요. 피로가 풀려요.
lines.beaver_en: Use the sauna after working out too. It relieves fatigue.
lines.beaver_roman: undong hueneun saunado haseyo. piroga pullyeoyo.
lines.learner: 어제 사우나를 했더니 잠을 잘 잤어요.
lines.en: I used the sauna yesterday and slept well.
lines.roman: eoje saunareul haetdeoni jameul jal jasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 많이 아프면 마사지를 받는 것도 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: If it hurts a lot, getting a massage is good too.
lines.beaver_roman: mani apeumyeon masajireul banneun geotdo joayo.
lines.learner: 그럼 사우나 후에 마사지를 받아 볼게요.
lines.en: Then I'll try getting a massage after the sauna.
lines.roman: geureom sauna hue masajireul bada bolgeyo.

lines.beaver: 네. 그럼 이제 자전거부터 천천히 타 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Okay. Now, shall we start slowly with the bike?
lines.beaver_roman: ne. geureom ije jajeongeobuteo cheoncheonhi ta bolkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 오늘은 운동량을 줄여서 천천히 할게요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll cut back today and take it slow.
lines.roman: ne, oneureun undongnyangeul juryeoseo cheoncheonhi halgeyo.
